content.text: {"words":[{"ref":0,"lemma":"Schreibtisch","exampleDe":"Mein Laptop liegt auf dem Schreibtisch.","exampleTranslation":"My laptop is on the desk.","plural":"Schreibtische","forms":null},{"ref":1,"lemma":"Garage","exampleDe":"Das Auto steht in der Garage.","exampleTranslation":"The car is in the garage.","plural":null,"forms":null},{"ref":2,"lemma":"Kühlschrank","exampleDe":"Die Milch ist im Kühlschrank.","exampleTranslation":"The milk is in the fridge.","plural":"Kühlschränke","forms":null},{"ref":3,"lemma":"Arbeit","exampleDe":"Ich fahre mit dem Bus zur Arbeit.","exampleTranslation":"I take the bus to work.","plural":"Arbeiten","forms":null},{"ref":4,"lemma":"verkaufen","exampleDe":"Wir verkaufen unser altes Fahrrad.","exampleTranslation":"We are selling our old bike.","plural":null,"forms":{"praeteritum":"verkaufte","partizip2":"verkauft","auxiliary":"haben"}},{"ref":5,"lemma":"sehen","exampleDe":"Ich sehe meine Freundin im Park.","exampleTranslation":"I see my girlfriend in the park.","plural":null,"forms":{"praeteritum":"sah","partizip2":"gesehen","auxiliary":"haben"}},{"ref":6,"lemma":"vermieten","exampleDe":"Herr Braun vermietet eine kleine Wohnung.","exampleTranslation":"Mr. Braun rents out a small apartment.","plural":null,"forms":null},{"ref":7,"lemma":"aufstehen","exampleDe":"Ich stehe jeden Tag um sieben Uhr auf.","exampleTranslation":"I get up at seven o'clock every day.","plural":null,"forms":{"praeteritum":"stand auf","partizip2":"aufgestanden","auxiliary":"sein"}},{"ref":8,"lemma":"möbliert","exampleDe":"Das Zimmer ist möbliert.","exampleTranslation":"The room is furnished.","plural":null,"forms":null},{"ref":9,"lemma":"ungefähr","exampleDe":"Die Wohnung kostet ungefähr 600 Euro.","exampleTranslation":"The apartment costs approximately 600 euros.","plural":null,"forms":null},{"ref":10,"lemma":"Stock","exampleDe":"Wir wohnen im dritten Stock.","exampleTranslation":"We live on the third floor.","plural":"Stockwerke","forms":null}]}
